content: Hi! How can I help you with the event files today?
Hey! I saw the link you sent, but I'm not sure which folder has the group photos.
Great question! Once you open the shared album, you'll see folders by activity, look for the one labeled 'Group Shots.' If you click that, all the big group photos are there.
Found them, these bring back so many good memories. Is it okay if I download the originals for personal scrapbooking?
Absolutely, please do! Just select the photos you want and hit 'Download originals.' Let me know if you need them zipped up for easier access.
A zip file would be perfect, actually. Also, I noticed some photos don't have captions, can I help add those?
That would be wonderful! If you click 'Edit captions' under any photo in the album, you can add a quick description or alt text for accessibility. It really helps everyone enjoy the memories.
Great, I'll add some captions. Do you still need people to upload any missing shots from the awards ceremony?
Yes, if you have any, just click the 'Upload' button in the 'Ceremony Highlights' folder. Even a few extra snapshots can make a big difference in the album.
Uploading a few now! Also, is there a highlight video somewhere? I heard someone was editing clips together.
You heard right! The highlight video is exporting now, it'll be in the 'Videos' folder soon. I'll ping you once it's ready to view and download.
Awesome, I can't wait. Thanks for making everything so easy to find and for encouraging captions, makes it feel more complete.
Thank you for helping organize! Be sure to browse the album later for any updates. Let me know if you need a private link to share with family, or have other ideas for the folder.
